scope: Moesi runtime migration to exact local Cetane 0.0.2; no publication or public-chain execution

cetaneTarball.source: local working tree with Moesi migration support
cetaneTarball.command: bun run build && bun pm pack --ignore-scripts --destination ../moesi/vendor/cetane

checks.moesi: bun run check: 53 boundary fixtures; lint, build, typecheck; 566 core, 63 OAAth adapter and 150 CLI tests
checks.onchain: 24 local Anvil tests; node scripts/test-cli-anvil.mjs; node scripts/test-packed-anvil.mjs (includes packed OAAth proof and all four examples)
checks.packed: node scripts/smoke-packed-library.mjs and node scripts/smoke-packed-cli.mjs; exact Cetane tarball override; real local/RPC client types and probes; CLI consumer contains no viem installation
checks.cetane: bun run check; bun run test:node (601 tests on each runtime); bun run test:package (Node, Bun and browser consumers)
checks.install: bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts; unrelated dependency versions retained

requiredCetaneAdditions: Ordinary eth_sendTransaction RPC wallet with exact sender and no automatic retry
Frozen, identifiable built-in EVM execution module
CREATE/CREATE2 address, checksum, digest recovery and hex utilities
Pinned getCode, code-only eth_call state overrides, and block-header reads
remainingLimitations: Cetane local EOA execution and the Moesi CLI require EIP-1559 and compatible fee RPC methods; legacy-only local signing is unsupported
Pinned OAAth SDK still uses viem; independent test oracles keep viem dev dependencies
The new public moesi/cetane subpath and cetane provider identity replace moesi/viem; no compatibility aliases

performance.kind: one synthetic sample, simulated 10 ms latency; no live-provider claim
performance.interpretation: Same plan ID, 182 RPC method calls and 42 batched HTTP exchanges as the previously optimized viem fixture. Migration preserves RPC savings; this single sample does not establish a latency improvement.
performance.bundleBudgetChange: Only the all-portable-modules ceiling increased, to 51400, for newly exported ABI parsers and deployment utilities. Existing core/read/local-signer ceilings retained.
